title: Joint Supervision UGM – UPM: Smart Agri UGM Researcher Participates in Research Exchange at Universiti Putra Malaysia for Spectral Sensor Utilization in Indoor Farming

body:
**Serdang, Malaysia** – Arifa Haryani, a master's student in Agricultural Engineering from the Department of Agricultural Engineering and Biosystems, Faculty of Agricultural Technology UGM, participated in a week-long research exchange program at Universiti Putra Malaysia (UPM) on December 16-26, 2024. The program is part of a joint supervision collaboration between UGM and UPM funded by the Directorate of Partnerships and Global Relations UGM, with the principal advisor being Ir. Andri Prima Nugroho, Ph.D., IPU., ASEAN Eng at the Smart Agriculture Research Center (SARC) UGM. The co-advisor is Assoc. Prof. Dr. Nazmi Mat Nawi, Head of the Department of Biological and Agricultural Engineering at UPM. Arifa's research focus is on the utilization of spectral sensors to enhance plant quality in indoor farming systems.

![](/brand/uploads/notes/275-1-exchange-lab-tour.webp)

Laboratory Tour and viewing of sensor prototype developed in the Laboratory

During her visit, Arifa not only had the opportunity to initiate her research but also gained valuable additional experiences. She visited UPM's spectral laboratory, where she was introduced to spectral analysis technology for plant quality assessment. Arifa learned how spectral instruments work in detecting plant health based on spectral reflectance values and light wavelengths reflected, using instruments such as Spectroscopy C Circuit, HR 4000CG-UV-NIR, Ocean optics halogen light square HL 2000, and SPAD. She also trained in analyzing data from several plant samples, comparing data from SPAD and spectroscopy using Spectragryph software. Assoc. Prof. Nazmi provided important guidance, such as optimizing sensor positioning to improve data accuracy and recommending the number of measurement repetitions for each treatment.

![](/brand/uploads/notes/275-2-exchange-upm-lab-activity--768x1024.webp)

Arifa conducting observations at UPM Laboratory

Through this program, Arifa obtained valuable input regarding optimization of her research methodology, including sensor placement, sample size, and real-time spectral data collection. Hands-on practical experience in analyzing spectral data using spectroscopy enhanced her skills and supported further research. Discussions and presentations during the visit strengthened academic relationships between the two universities, paving the way for future research collaboration. By implementing the recommendations obtained, the quality and validity of Arifa's research are expected to improve significantly.

The success of this program demonstrates the commitment of UGM and UPM in promoting innovation and international collaboration in the field of agriculture, while contributing to the achievement of the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) through improved productivity and food security. The integration of advanced technology such as spectral sensors in indoor farming aligns with the SDGs' focus on sustainable agricultural practices and increased agricultural productivity.

Arifa expressed her gratitude for the opportunity to participate in this program, stating that the experience has broadened her perspective on agricultural research and technology. She emphasized the importance of collaboration among institutions to address global challenges in agriculture, particularly in the context of food security and sustainability. The knowledge gained from UPM will surely influence her future research efforts and contribute to the development of innovative solutions in the agricultural sector.

As the world faces increasingly pressing challenges related to food production and environmental sustainability, initiatives such as the UGM-UPM joint supervision program play an important role in preparing future agricultural engineers with the skills and knowledge needed to drive positive change. This collaboration not only enhances academic learning but also fosters the spirit of innovation essential for addressing the urgent issues of our time.

original.body:
**Serdang, Malaysia** – Arifa Haryani, mahasiswa Program Studi S2 Teknik Pertanian dari Departemen Teknik Pertanian dan Biosistem, Fakultas Teknologi Pertanian UGM, mengikuti program pertukaran riset selama seminggu di Universiti Putra Malaysia (UPM) pada 16-26 Desember 2024. Program ini merupakan bagian dari kerjasama \*_joint supervision_\* antara UGM dan UPM yang didanai Direktorat Kemitraan dan Relasi Global UGM, dengan Pembimbing utama Ir. Andri Prima Nugroho, Ph.D., IPU., ASEAN Eng di Smart Agriculture Research Center (SARC) UGM. Sedangkan pembimbing mitra adalah Assoc. Prof. Dr. Nazmi Mat Nawi, Ketua Departemen Teknik Biologi dan Pertanian UPM. Fokus penelitian Arifa adalah pemanfaatan sensor spektral untuk meningkatkan kualitas tanaman dalam sistem _indoor farming_.

![](/brand/uploads/notes/275-1-exchange-lab-tour.webp)

Laboratory Tour dan melihat prototype sensor yang dikembangkan di Laboratorium

Selama kunjungannya, Arifa tidak hanya diberikan kesempatan untuk memulai penelitiannya, tetapi juga mendapatkan pengalaman berharga lainnya. Ia mengunjungi laboratorium spektral UPM, di mana ia diperkenalkan dengan teknologi analisis spektral untuk penilaian kualitas tanaman. Arifa mempelajari cara kerja alat spektral dalam mendeteksi kesehatan tanaman berdasarkan nilai reflektan spektral dan panjang gelombang cahaya yang dipantulkan, menggunakan alat seperti Spektroskopi C Circuit, HR 4000CG-UV-NIR, Ocean optics halogen light square HL 2000, dan SPAD. Ia juga berlatih menganalisis data dari beberapa sampel tanaman, membandingkan data dari SPAD dan spektroskopi menggunakan perangkat lunak Spectragryph. Assoc. Prof. Nazmi memberikan arahan penting, seperti mengoptimalkan posisi sensor untuk meningkatkan akurasi data dan merekomendasikan jumlah pengulangan pengukuran untuk setiap perlakuan.

![](/brand/uploads/notes/275-2-exchange-upm-lab-activity--768x1024.webp)

Arifa sedang melakukan pengamatan di Laboratorium UPM

Melalui program ini, Arifa memperoleh masukan berharga terkait optimalisasi metode penelitiannya, termasuk penempatan sensor, jumlah sampel, dan pengambilan data spektral _real-time_. Pengalaman praktik langsung dalam menganalisis data spektral menggunakan spektroskopi meningkatkan keterampilannya dan mendukung penelitian lebih lanjut. Diskusi dan presentasi selama kunjungan memperkuat hubungan akademik antara kedua universitas, membuka jalan bagi kolaborasi riset di masa depan. Dengan menerapkan saran yang diperoleh, kualitas dan validitas penelitian Arifa diharapkan meningkat secara signifikan.

Keberhasilan program ini menunjukkan komitmen UGM dan UPM dalam mendorong inovasi dan kolaborasi internasional di bidang pertanian, sekaligus berkontribusi pada pencapaian Tujuan Pembangunan Berkelanjutan (SDGs) melalui peningkatan produktivitas dan ketahanan pangan. Integrasi teknologi canggih seperti sensor spektral dalam _indoor farming_ sejalan dengan fokus SDGs pada praktik pertanian yang berkelanjutan dan peningkatan produktivitas pertanian.

Arifa mengungkapkan rasa syukurnya atas kesempatan untuk berpartisipasi dalam program ini, menyatakan bahwa pengalaman tersebut telah memperluas perspektifnya tentang penelitian dan teknologi pertanian. Ia menekankan pentingnya kolaborasi antara institusi untuk mengatasi tantangan global dalam pertanian, terutama dalam konteks ketahanan pangan dan keberlanjutan. Pengetahuan yang diperoleh dari UPM pasti akan mempengaruhi upaya penelitian masa depannya dan berkontribusi pada pengembangan solusi inovatif di sektor pertanian.

Seiring dunia menghadapi tantangan yang semakin meningkat terkait produksi pangan dan keberlanjutan lingkungan, inisiatif seperti program joint supervision UGM-UPM memainkan peran penting dalam mempersiapkan insinyur pertanian masa depan dengan keterampilan dan pengetahuan yang diperlukan untuk mendorong perubahan positif. Kolaborasi ini tidak hanya meningkatkan pembelajaran akademis tetapi juga mendorong semangat inovasi yang sangat penting untuk mengatasi isu-isu mendesak di zaman kita.
